task_name: Vocabulary seeding at every workspace-creation path

strengths: Single shared `seedTrackerVocabulary` helper imported by all three production workspace-creation paths (`workspaces.ts`, `auth.ts`, `oauth.ts`)
Seeding runs inside each existing creation transaction, so a seed failure rolls back workspace creation
`DEFAULT_TRACKER_VOCABULARY` matches schema.sql names, positions (via `POSITION_GAP`), colours, and status categories
Coupling comments present on both `tracker-vocabulary-seed.ts` and the `schema.sql` retroactive seed block
Unit tests cover row counts, categories, position ordering, and single-batch insert behavior; server suite passes

issues.description: No integration test asserts vocabulary rows exist after workspace creation through the three HTTP paths; coverage relies on unit tests and transactional call-site placement
